## sacct_state_filter_test
cmd: echo "-s CD without -E:"; sacct -u $USER -S now-14days -X -P -n -s CD --format=JobID,State | head -3; echo "-s CD with -E now:"; sacct -u $USER -S now-14days -E now -X -P -n -s CD --format=JobID,State | head -3; echo "-s COMPLETED,FAILED with -E now:"; sacct -u $USER -S now-14days -E now -X -P -n -s COMPLETED,FAILED --format=JobID,State | head -3
rc=0 ms=117
